Only once. This phone has no screen lock, so you\'ll type the key\'s password each time you sign.
Choose the key file from NCA or egov.kz. It usually starts with GOSTKNCA.
Don\'t have a key? Get one free on egov.kz or in the eGov Mobile app.
Tap to choose another key file
The one from NCA\'s center or egov.kz. It is never saved.
The key stays on this phone, locked by its security chip. Only your fingerprint or screen lock opens it.
This phone has no screen lock, so the key will ask for this password each time you sign. Set a screen lock in Settings to sign with your fingerprint instead.
That password doesn\'t open this key.
Is the keyboard in Russian or Kazakh?
Switch it to English and try again.
Forgot it? NCA can\'t recover it. Get a new key on egov.kz.
This file isn\'t a signature key. Choose the .p12 file from NCA or egov.kz.
This key is already on this phone.
Confirm it\'s you to lock the key on this phone
It starts working on %1$s. Check that the phone\'s date is right.
This key is too old to sign
It\'s a GOST 2004 key. NCA no longer confirms the time of its signatures, so documents signed with it aren\'t accepted.
On egov.kz or in the eGov Mobile app, under “Get a digital signature”. It\'s free. Then add the new key here.
Get a new key on egov.kz before then.
It can\'t sign anymore. Get a new key on egov.kz.
Not valid yet. Check that the phone\'s date is right.
Get a new key on egov.kz.
Opens with your fingerprint and its password
To sign again, you\'ll need the key file and its password. The key itself stays valid: this only removes it from this phone.
Your documents stay on your phone
When you sign or check, only a short fingerprint of the document goes to NCA, never the document itself. Your key never leaves the phone. No accounts, no tracking.
NCA: key check and signing time (pki.gov.kz)
Only once. This phone can\'t keep keys in a security chip, so you\'ll type the key\'s password each time you sign.
This phone has no security chip for keys, so the key will ask for this password each time you sign.
This file is too big to sign on the phone.
This PDF can\'t be shown here.
Choose a file and confirm with your fingerprint
Choose a file and confirm with your screen lock
Choose a file and confirm with the key\'s password
Got a file in Telegram or WhatsApp? Tap Share on it and choose kzsigner. It opens in the right place.
Unlocks after you open the document
Your signature goes inside this PDF, and a stamp with your name is added on its last page, so anyone can see it\'s signed.
Your signature is added inside this PDF, next to %1$s\'s. Send this PDF back.
Your signature goes inside this XML file. Send that file.
You get one .cms file with the document and your signature inside. Send that file.
Your signature joins %1$s\'s in the same file. Send that one file back.
This .cms holds only signatures, not the document itself. Ask the sender for the .cms with the document inside.
This XML file is signed in a way that another signature would break. Ask the sender for a copy without signatures.
Signing needs internet: NCA confirms your key is valid and records the official signing time. Connect to Wi-Fi or mobile data.
NCA\'s servers didn\'t answer. Try again in a few minutes.
This phone has no screen lock, so the key asks for its password each time. Set a screen lock in Settings to sign with your fingerprint instead.
This phone can\'t keep keys in a security chip, so the key asks for its password each time.
This phone reset the key\'s protection (the screen lock was removed or a fingerprint added). Remove the key in Your keys and add the key file again.
No app on this phone opens this file.
Send the file, not a printout
The signature is inside the file. The stamp on the last page only shows who signed; a printed copy is just paper.
The signature is inside the file. A printed copy is just paper.
To sign %1$s, first add your key. You\'ll come straight back to it.
NCA says this key no longer works. A key is revoked when a new one is issued or the old one is reported lost.
